解答　在极坐标系下，积分区域 $D$ 的积分限为 $-\frac{\pi}{2}\leq\theta\leq\frac{\pi}{2},0\leq r\leq2\cos\theta$，于是

search_text:
若区域 $D:x^2+y^2\leq2x$，则二重积分 $\iint_D(x+y)\sqrt{x^2+y^2}\,dxdy$ 化成累次积分为[\quad] $2\int_0^{\pi/2}(\cos\theta+\sin\theta)d\theta\int_0^{2\cos\theta}r^3dr$ $\int_{-\pi/2}^{\pi/2}(\cos\theta+\sin\theta)d\theta\int_0^{2\cos\theta}r^3dr$ $\int_{-\pi/2}^{\pi/2}d\theta\int_0^{2\cos\theta}(\cos\theta+\sin\theta)\sqrt{2r\cos\theta}\,dr$ $\int_0^\pi(\cos\theta+\sin\theta)d\theta\int_0^{2\cos\theta}r^3dr$ 解答　在极坐标系下，积分区域 $D$ 的积分限为 $-\frac{\pi}{2}\leq\theta\leq\frac{\pi}{2},0\leq r\leq2\cos\theta$，于是

$$\iint_D(x+y)\sqrt{x^2+y^2}dxdy=\int_{-\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}(\cos\theta+\sin\theta)d\theta\int_0^{2\cos\theta}r^3dr.$$
